name: wide to narrow push up
description: A push-up where the hands move from a wide to a narrow position between reps. It shifts the load from chest to triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor with your body in a straight line.
Push back up to the top.
Walk your hands in to a narrow, close position.
Repeat a push-up, then step your hands back out wide.
